updates.title: Microsoft Purview: View-Only Device Management Role for Endpoint DLP
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview is introducing a new View-Only Device Management role that grants least-privilege access to device onboarding status without requiring broad administrative roles like Global Administrator. This enables auditors and security analysts to monitor endpoint DLP device configuration while reducing excessive permission grants.

updates.title: CVE-2026-80092: Microsoft Identity Web Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: Microsoft Identity Web versions 3 and 4 contain an elevation of privilege vulnerability that has been addressed in versions 3.16.0 and 4.16.1 respectively. Organizations using older versions should update immediately to prevent attackers from escalating privileges in identity-enabled applications.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention Expands to Microsoft Cowork
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview DLP is now extending to Microsoft Cowork, enabling security admins to enforce consistent data protection policies across Copilot and Cowork interactions by blocking sensitive information transfers and restricting labeled knowledge sources. This unifies DLP governance across AI and collaborative workspaces.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Retention Policies Based on Last Accessed Date in OneDrive and SharePoint
updates.summary: Organizations can now apply retention labels and policies to files in OneDrive and SharePoint based on when content was last accessed by users. This capability enables smarter data lifecycle management by targeting inactive or obsolete content for retention or deletion actions.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Archive SharePoint Files Under Retention Policies
updates.summary: Administrators can now configure retention policies to archive inactive SharePoint files to low-cost storage rather than only keeping or deleting them. This extends data lifecycle management in Purview to include archiving actions, lowering storage costs while maintaining data discoverability and compliance.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Compliance Manager Integration with AI Foundry for Agent Compliance Mapping
updates.summary: Purview Compliance Manager is integrating with Microsoft AI Foundry to automatically map AI agents against compliance regulations and evaluate control compliance posture. This enables organizations to monitor and improve compliance status of AI agents throughout their lifecycle.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Purview SDK Embedded in Agent Framework SDK
updates.summary: The Purview SDK is now embedded in the Agent Framework SDK, allowing developers to automatically integrate data classification, protection, and compliance controls into AI agents they build. This provides built-in sensitive data handling, leak prevention, and regulatory visibility without requiring separate integration effort.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint DLP Now Monitors FTP and SFTP Transfers
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview Endpoint DLP has reached general availability for monitoring sensitive data transfers over FTP and SFTP protocols, with support for applying restrictive actions based on organizational policies. This closes a gap in data protection for traditional file transfer methods commonly used in regulated environments.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Network Data Security Integration with Entra Global Secure Access
updates.summary: Purview Network Data Security now integrates with Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access to enforce DLP policies at the network layer, protecting data across browsers, apps, APIs, and generative AI platforms. This prevents sensitive data leakage to untrusted cloud apps while enabling Insider Risk Management detection.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Information Barriers Policy Compliance Report
updates.summary: A new Information Barriers compliance report enables administrators to identify SharePoint sites, OneDrive accounts, and SharePoint Embedded containers that no longer comply with Information Barriers policies after policy changes. This helps maintain governance over communication and data sharing restrictions.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Auto-Expanding Archive Mailboxes Beyond 1.5 TB Limit
updates.summary: Archive mailboxes can now automatically expand beyond the previous 1.5 TB limit for customers with eligible E5 licenses, ensuring mailbox operability and continuous retention capability. This removes a scaling constraint that previously forced admins to intervene when archives reached capacity.
